name: Galentine's Night Out at F45 Branham Park
description: 45 minutes of strength training work out followed by bubbles. Each F45 workout is a unique program that incorporates cardio, resistance-based strength training, or a hybrid of both, all geared toward everyday life.

description: Mention Los Alamitos and 25% of proceeds will be donated to the PTA!!

name: Yearbook Cover Contest (5th Graders Only)
description: Los Alamitos PTA is inviting all Los Alamitos 5th graders to enter their drawings for the Yearbook cover contest. 2 winners will be selected to be displayed on the front and back cover.

name: Variety Show – Volunteers & Important Info
description: Volunteer opportunities include Stage Hands to assist performers and Concession Organizer to coordinate snacks and sales. Audition videos are due by 3/1, dress rehearsal is on 3/19, and the show is on 3/20.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. Volunteers are needed once per week (Tues, Wed, or Thurs) during the school year.

name: Yearbook Orders
description: Last day to order the 2025-26 Yearbook. 5th grade parents need to submit baby photos by 3/1 for the 5th Grade Baby Pages.

name: Middle School Selection Process
description: Families will submit school choice requests online through the School Choice section of Parent Portal, which will be open from 1/20 through 2/13.

name: Sponsor Spotlight - Amato Pizzeria
description: Amato Pizzeria serves up delicious pies with quality ingredients and old-school love. It's the perfect spot for family dinner night — and support for a local favorite.
